text:
PM collapses to 1.8° because the Ahuja feedback goes into node a2. That pole sits at about gm_c/Cc, which tracks UGBW because gm_c is only about 2·gm1. Raising gm_c means lowering gmid1, and that is what pushed noise up. I'm moving to Miller compensation with a zero-cancelling resistor (Cc + Rz to node x). Then the non-dominant pole becomes 1/(Rz·C1), about gm7·Cc/(C1·CL), and gmid1 can return to about 20 for noise.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Ahuja node pole ratio gm_c/gm1 is fixed ~2 so PM collapses and low gmid1 kills noise. Move Cc to the high-Z node x with series Rz cancelling p2; non-dominant pole becomes 1/(Rz*C1). Allows gmid1~20 for noise. Trim currents for power, Lp shorter for mirror pole."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Itail": (11.0e-6, 9e-6, 12.5e-6),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Iout":  (15.0e-6, 13e-6, 16.5e-6),
    "Cc":    (0.42e-12, 0.25e-12, 0.8e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.7, 1.6),
    "gmidb": (17.0, 12.0, 20.0),
    "Lb":    (3.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "gmidc": (22.0, 14.0, 25.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    Itail = p["Itail"]
    Iout = p["Iout"]
    # sim shows ~3-5% mirror over-current; keep margin under 68 uW
    imax = 36.3e-6 - iref
    if 1.05 * Itail + 1.02 * Iout > imax:
        Iout = max((imax - 1.05 * Itail) / 1.02, 10e-6)
    Ih = Itail / 2
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Lc = 0.5
    vds1 = 0.2

    # ---- NMOS bias mirror ----
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    for _ in range(3):
        mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5t = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=0.2)
    vtail_min = m5t.vdsat + 0.08

    # ---- input pair with body effect ----
    vtail = 0.25
    for _ in range(5):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=vds1, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, vtail_min)
    vd1 = vtail + vds1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=vds1, vsb=vtail)

    # ---- PMOS mirror ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=1.1)
    for _ in range(3):
        m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = m3
    vdd1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # ---- NMOS cascodes (gain only, not in compensation path) ----
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], Lc, Ih, vds=max(vdd1 - vd1, 0.12), vsb=vd1)
    vcasn = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # ---- output PMOS: Vgs7 == Vgs3 ----
    lo, hi = 4.0, 22.0
    m7 = lut.size("p", 0.5 * (lo + hi), p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)
    for _ in range(18):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        m7 = lut.size("p", g, p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)
        if m7.vgs > m3.vgs:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    gmid7 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmid7, p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=vtail)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    Rcas = max((vcasn - mb.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    # ---- Miller with zero-cancelling Rz: zero placed on output pole ----
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + mc.cdd + 8e-15
    gm7 = m7.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 / gm7) * (1.0 + (cl + C1) / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("Rcas", "ibias", "nb", Rcas)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1c", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2c", "x", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("Rz", "x", "xz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "xz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (mc.gds * m1.gds + 1e-30)
    g1 = m4.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A1 = gm1 / g1
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    ugbw = 0.9 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / gm7, 1.0))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + mc.cdd))
    fcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 3e-15))
    dg = math.degrees
    pm = 90 - dg(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) \
         - (dg(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - dg(math.atan(ugbw / z))) \
         - 0.5 * (dg(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) - dg(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fmir)))) \
         - dg(math.atan(ugbw / fcas))
    slew = 0.9 * min(Itail / Cc, Iout / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.8 / slew + 7 * tau
    # calibrated: 105 nV @ gmid24/L2.2, 384 nV @ gmid13/L2 -> ~gmid^-2.1
    noise_1k = 105e-9 * (2.2 / p["L1"]) * (24.0 / p["gmid1"]) ** 2.1 * math.sqrt(5.9e-6 / Ih)
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / (m5.gds + 1e-30) * 4.0
    swing = vdd - (max(m7.vdsat, 0.08) + max(m8.vdsat, 0.08))
    power = vdd * (iref + 1.05 * Itail + 1.02 * Iout)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(A0) + 4,
        "swing": swing,
        "power": power,
    }
```
